blocks.speaker: narrator
blocks.text: Jesus and his disciples were passing through Samaria. They came to a town called Sychar, near the well Jacob dug a long time ago. Jesus was tired from the road, so he sat down by the well while his disciples went into town to buy food.

blocks.speaker: narrator
blocks.text: A Samaritan woman came to draw water. It was about the sixth hour, the middle of the day, with the sun high.

verses.text: There cometh a woman of Samaria to draw water: Jesus saith unto her, Give me to drink.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: There cometh a woman of Samaria to draw water: Jesus saith unto her, Give me to drink.

verses.text: Then saith the woman of Samaria unto him, How is it that thou, being a Jew, askest drink of me, which am a woman of Samaria? for the Jews have no dealings with the Samaritans.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Then saith the woman of Samaria unto him,

segments.speaker: woman
segments.text: How is it that thou, being a Jew, askest drink of me, which am a woman of Samaria? for the Jews have no dealings with the Samaritans.

blocks.speaker: narrator
blocks.text: Jews and Samaritans did not mix. A Jewish teacher was not supposed to be talking to a Samaritan woman at a well, much less asking her for a drink. Jesus stepped right over that line.

blocks.speaker: narrator
blocks.text: He told her that if she knew who was asking, she would have asked him, and he would have given her living water. She told him he did not even have a bucket, and the well was deep.

verses.text: Jesus answered and said unto her, Whosoever drinketh of this water shall thirst again:

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Jesus answered and said unto her, Whosoever drinketh of this water shall thirst again:

verses.text: But whosoever drinketh of the water that I shall give him shall never thirst; but the water that I shall give him shall be in him a well of water springing up into everlasting life.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: But whosoever drinketh of the water that I shall give him shall never thirst; but the water that I shall give him shall be in him a well of water springing up into everlasting life.

verses.text: The woman saith unto him, Sir, give me this water, that I thirst not, neither come hither to draw.

segments.speaker: woman
segments.text: Sir, give me this water, that I thirst not, neither come hither to draw.

blocks.speaker: narrator
blocks.text: Then Jesus told her to go call her husband. She said she did not have one. Jesus told her she was right. She had had five husbands, and the man she had now was not her husband. Listen, Church. He did not shame her. He did not preach at her. He just knew her whole story.

blocks.speaker: narrator
blocks.text: She told him she could see he was a prophet. She asked him where folks ought to worship. Jesus told her a time was coming when true worship would not depend on a mountain or a city, but on spirit and truth. She said she knew the Messiah was coming. And Jesus told her plain, he was the one.

blocks.speaker: narrator
blocks.text: Right then the disciples came back, surprised to find him talking with her. But nobody asked him why.

verses.text: The woman then left her waterpot, and went her way into the city, and saith to the men,

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: The woman then left her waterpot, and went her way into the city, and saith to the men,

verses.text: Come, see a man, which told me all things that ever I did: is not this the Christ?

segments.speaker: woman
segments.text: Come, see a man, which told me all things that ever I did: is not this the Christ?

blocks.speaker: narrator
blocks.text: She left her water pot. She came for water and found something more. The woman who came to that well by herself at noon went straight back to town and told everybody.

verses.text: And said unto the woman, Now we believe, not because of thy saying: for we have heard him ourselves, and know that this is indeed the Christ, the Saviour of the world.

segments.speaker: samaritans
segments.text: Now we believe, not because of thy saying: for we have heard him ourselves, and know that this is indeed the Christ, the Saviour of the world.

blocks.speaker: narrator
blocks.text: Say it with me. Somebody say, come and see. [PAUSE 3s | screen: "Come and see"] Come and see. [PAUSE 3s | screen: "Come and see"] That was her whole sermon.

blocks.speaker: narrator
blocks.text: A Samaritan woman with a complicated past became the one who carried this news to her whole town, and many believed because of what she said. Jesus met her where she was, told her the truth with kindness, and sent her home with a testimony.
